title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
abstract: arXiv:2608.30320v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We describe the architecture and ablations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 125B parameters, 6B activated per token, and additional 51B parameters of n-gram embedding tables held off the accelerator. On fourteen pre-training benchmarks the model leads the 397B-A17B predecessor on eight and trails it on the rest by at most 2.6 points, at 1/3 the activated parameters, 1/3 the training tokens, and roughly 1/9 the training FLOPs. Token mixing uses a layer-wise hybrid of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and global attention, with one full-attention layer in every four; at continued-pretraining time those full-attention layers are replaced by Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA), which scores context at micro-block granularity with a compressed lightweight indexer. translated_title: 关于Qwen3.8-Next架构的设计：评估、效率与训练稳定性
translated_abstract: 我们描述了Qwen3.8-Flash-Next的架构设计与消融实验，这是一个稀疏混合专家模型，总参数量为125B，每个token激活6B参数，另外还有51B参数的n-gram嵌入表保存在加速器之外。在十四个预训练基准测试中，该模型在八个基准上领先397B-A17B的前代模型，在其余基准上落后不超过2.6分，而其激活参数量仅为前代的1/3，训练token量仅为1/3，训练FLOPs约为1/9。Token混合采用Gated DeltaNet（GDN）与全局注意力的逐层混合方式，每四层中仅有一层为全注意力层；在继续预训练阶段，这些全注意力层被Qwen稀疏注意力（QSA）所取代，QSA通过一个压缩的轻量级索引器以微块粒度对上下文进行评分。残差流被拓宽为四个分支，并通过逐元素门控进行读取，我们将这一设计称为门控残差（GR）。模型容量通过在主干网络之外添加……（原文在此截断）
tldr: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next通过稀疏混合专家架构、GDN与Qwen稀疏注意力的混合设计以及门控残差机制，仅用约1/9的训练计算量和1/3的激活参数就达到了接近397B前代模型的性能。
en_tdlr: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next matches its 397B-A17B predecessor on most benchmarks with roughly 1/9 of the training FLOPs and 1/3 of the activated parameters, via a sparse MoE design combining Gated DeltaNet, Qwen Sparse Attention, and a Gated Residual architecture.
